newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra says launches cable internet service.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra says launches cable internet service.

text.p: Australia's state-owned telecommunications group, Telstra Corp, on Wednesday launched Internet access over its broadband cable network.

"(Pay-tv service) Foxtel was the first service on our cable and now has over 100,000 customers; cable internet is the second and offers as much if not more potential," Telstra Multimedia chief executive officer Gerry Moriarty said in a statement.
Internet access over the cable network was up to 50 times faster than traditional analogue modem technology, Telstra said.
Telstra's cable network passes over 1.5 million Australian households.
Subscriptions to the new service are priced at A$95 a month plus a usage charge.
Foxtel is an equal joint venture between Telstra and News Corp.
